mentions.name: 3D printing experiments
mentions.description: 3D printing projects centered on a used SV06+ printer and a friend's Ender that was resurrected using cleaning tools and tinkering research. Ongoing prints include parts trays, Skadis panels, a case for an old Framework mainboard, and instrument stands for workspace cleanup and repairing/reusing existing items, alongside sketching out printed items that could be sold.
mentions.source_excerpt: 3D printing experiments. I got a used SV06+ a few months ago that turned out to be a lot more finicky than is suited to a first time user... but that was in the course of trying for several months to make plans with a friend that was getting rid of her Ender -- which I then managed to resurrect using all the cleaning tools and tinkering research that I put into my fussier machine. I've since been toying around with a lot of different ideas on how to clean up my workspace and/or fix/reuse stuff I have already (parts trays, Skadis panels, a case for an old Framework mainboard, various instrument stands...) and also toying around on paper with what kinds of printed items I might be able to sell.
mentions.author: chaosharmonic
